5267-5330-7924.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing a Clue.
Ulvenwald Mysteries' second ability triggers, creating a Clue token due to Flitwing.
Resolve the Atog ability, giving Atog +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

3480-4770-6090-6723.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4125-5531-5694-6664-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
4125-5531-5694-6664-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Shipwreck Dowser and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Shipwreck Dowser and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat.
4125-5531-5694-6664-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Shipwreck Dowser and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

6495-6754-7084.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Eusocial Engineering triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
6495-6754-7084.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature that has power 2 or greater

1987-2493-7907.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-2493-7907.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Archaeomancer.
When Archaeomancer enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2493-7907.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

876-7070-7704.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Doc Samson.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Doc Samson.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Doc Samson.
Activate Doc Samson by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Doc Samson.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Doc Samson.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Doc Samson from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.

141-3125-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have two creature cards in your graveyard.
141-3125-5256.description:
Cast Victimize by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Victimize.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Victimize
Resolve the Victimize copy, sacrificing a creature and returning Naru Meha and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1251-4613-5310-5477-5627.easyPrerequisites: There is a land card in your library.
1251-4613-5310-5477-5627.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Bloodghast that is untapped and that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1251-4613-5310-5477-5627.description:
Activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, searching your library for a land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Repeat using the Plant instead until no lands are in your library.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5686-6972-7338.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Putrid Pals.
When Putrid Pals dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1402-2218-4763-7292.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Ronin Warclub triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

719-2366-5226-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
719-2366-5226-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

2034-2999-3490-4017.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2999-3490-4017.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

2034-3991-6132.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Repeat from step 3.

1385-3054-3416-5670.easyPrerequisites:
You've gained life this turn if Oathsworn Vampire is in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
1385-3054-3416-5670.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire either from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Edgar triggers, creating a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 once, sacrificing the Vampire token instead.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

2103-4423-5967-6886.easyPrerequisites:
You control three other Islands.
There is another nonbasic land on the battlefield.
2103-4423-5967-6886.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Dust Bowl by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, destroying a nonbasic land.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou during your draw step.
Repeat.

700-2770-3862.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has two or more cards in hand.
700-2770-3862.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal nonlethal damage to Body of Knowledge after it is donated to an opponent.
700-2770-3862.description:
Donate Body of Knowledge to an opponent that has two or more cards in hand, then deal nonlethal damage to it.
Body of Knowledge triggers, causing its controller to draw that many cards.
Orcish Bowmaster triggers for each card drawn. Resolve the first trigger, dealing 1 damage to Body of Knowledge and causing you to amass Orcs 1.
Repeat from step 2.

1947-2018-4053.description:
Activate Reckless Barbarian by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
When Reckless Barbarian dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Reckless Barbarian from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

224-907-1772-3875.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Coralhelm and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

856-1477-2267-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Tormod trigger.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

1486-1753-2872-5929.notablePrerequisites: Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
1486-1753-2872-5929.description:
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Clever Conjurer ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Clever Conjurer.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Repeat.
1486-1753-2872-5929.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

539-1659-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ashaya, adding {C}{C}.
When Ashaya dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Ashaya enters the battlefield, Seed the Land triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
539-1659-2034-5003.notes: If you control a nontoken creature that has haste, you may instead sacrifice it, and then tap it each iteration to get infinite green mana and colorless mana.

997-1365-1379-4853--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
997-1365-1379-4853--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

855-2060-4153.notablePrerequisites: A creature you control besides Crystalline Crawler has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
855-2060-4153.description:
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, removing at least five +1/+1 counters from a creature you control and putting at least ten +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters, adding {4}{W}.
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, removing five +1/+1 counters from Crystalline Crawler and putting ten +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, removing ten +1/+1 counters from that creature and putting twenty +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability ten times by removing ten +1/+1 counters, adding {8}{W}{W}.
Repeat from step 3 any number of times.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability any number of times.
855-2060-4153.notes: Note that the starting mana can come from activating Crystalline Crawler's mana ability. Starting mana is reduced if the creature starts with more than five +1/+1 counters on it.

2438-2724-3217-3582.description:
Activate Kaya the Inexorable's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting a ghostform counter on Wormfang Manta.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability and its ghostform ability trigger.
Resolve the ghostform trigger, returning Wormfang Manta from your graveyard to your hand and creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Tocatli Honor Guard.
Repeat each turn.

393-1242-1656.notablePrerequisites:
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
It is your precombat main phase.
393-1242-1656.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Necrotic Ooze using Alaborn Veteran's ability by tapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

379-3865-4440-4499-5311.manaNeeded: {1}{B} on your first turn, with {4}{B} available each extra turn
379-3865-4440-4499-5311.notablePrerequisites:
Varragoth does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Varragoth.
379-3865-4440-4499-5311.description:
Declare Varragoth as an attacker.
Activate Varragoth by paying {1}{B}, searching your library for Draco, then shuffling your library and putting Draco on top of it.
During the next upkeep, Timesifter triggers, exiling Draco and causing you to get an extra turn after this one.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Riftsweeper.
Riftsweeper enters the battlefield, shuffling Draco from exile into your library.
Repeat.

3871-4067.notablePrerequisites: You are able to activate Jodah's Codex's ability by paying {0}.
3871-4067.description:
Activate Jodah's Codex by tapping it, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Jodah's Codex.
Repeat.

413-1628-3197.notablePrerequisites:
Necrosynthesis attached to Herd Baloth.
You control another creature to sacrifice.
413-1628-3197.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a creature, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Necrosynthesis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Blasting Station triggers, untapping.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Beast token, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
